concept.title: Revoking the bootstrap token
concept.shortdesc: You can revoke the Red Hat Quay bootstrap OAuth token by disabling FEATURE_PROGRAMMATIC_BOOTSTRAP and restarting the registry. Red Hat Quay does not provide a separate API endpoint for instant revocation.

conbody.p: To revoke the bootstrap token, set FEATURE_PROGRAMMATIC_BOOTSTRAP: false and restart Red Hat Quay. Red Hat Quay deletes bootstrap-managed applications and tokens during startup.
